items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 75:1
items.html: They are from the filling of AB, the filling of MA and the filling of BON. And the filling of SAG is missing from them, because SAG serves here only as a passageway. The reason is that the GAR of SAG are covered Hassadim, whereas here they are revealed Hassadim in the illumination of Hochma, which is drawn from the level of AB. (Page 928, Item 106).
